revisions.text: We'll hunt them down and maurice a lead them. Well, not eat so much as pummel them to death.
We'll hunt them down and maurice elate them. Well, not eat so much as pummel them to death.

We'll hunt 'em down, and Maurice'll eat em. Well, not eat so much as pummel them to death.
